$comment: Extra WebSocket origins the page may connect to besides its own host (CSP connect-src). The curated public Nostr relays are not listed here: they come from data/nostr-relays.json (generated/relay-origins.json). Operators of a self-hosted build add their signaling origin through GS_CSP_CONNECT_ORIGINS (build) or --csp-connect-origin (guardedsleep-server).
